name: Anakapalli

sources.title: Andhra Pradesh Extraordinary Gazette index 2025 (G.O.Ms.No.515, Revenue (Lands-IV), 30 Dec 2025: creation of new revenue division at Adduroad Junction)
List of ULBs and UDAs covered under PMAY-U 2.0 (MoHUA, Government of India)
GOs issued on merger of two civic bodies, 10 panchayats - The Hindu

notes: The official mandals page already shows the new Adduroad Junction division (marked 'NEW') with 7 mandals, consistent with G.O.Ms.No.515 (30 Dec 2025). The district now has 24 mandals in 3 divisions. The official site writes the names in upper case; they are converted to title case here. The division is spelled 'Adduroad Junction' as in the G.O. and site; the brief calls it 'Adda Road'. The MoHUA PMAY-U 2.0 list also shows an 'Anakapalle, Municipal Corporation' with a new code (802949). It is excluded because the official district site says Anakapalle municipality was merged into Greater Visakhapatnam Municipal Corporation (G.O.Ms.No.373), the home page shows only 2 municipalities, and no de-merger notification was found. Parts of Anakapalli district, including Anakapalli town, are governed by GVMC, which is recorded under Visakhapatnam.
